scopeLimits: Este lote contém as entradas index-084–index-095. As demais linhas e o título permanecem em inglês até lotes próprios.

Inline uppercase callout markers and a separate Cinzel quantity glyph beside a declared weapon-hand symbol are folded into the adjacent prose row only when their ink boxes overlap. Live PT-BR PageRenderer text rects plus visible semantic-symbol rects for symbol-only rows are clustered by vertical centre (0.5 x median rect height); inline symbols overlapping a text row count with that row, not as extra lines. Candidate text and symbol IDs must match the selected renderer unit. For image-backed/raster-restored source text whose PDF extraction is incomplete, a candidate-scoped sourceVisualLineCountOverride may be used only with documented visual evidence. No character count, string newline count or frame-height estimate was used.
